title: WIII V2 integration and truth audit
outOfScope: Production code, schemas, semantic capability or multilingual-truth claim changes, provider configuration, release, tags, archives, and any corrective change; regenerated truth-document freshness and digest projections are allowed only as command-produced audit evidence. Task 11 is started only for documented truth drift.

sources.reason: Task 10 requirements and conditional Task 11 boundary.

riskAssessment.reason: An audit may overstate compatibility or fail to record a real documentation drift.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: The audit has bounded evidence, test, and no-change constraints.

preReviewWarnings: Review for unsupported claims and whether Task 11 is truly required.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Integration tests cover V1 explicit mode, V2 explicit mode, inconsistent sources, multi-item publication/rebuild, and absence of scheduler or network side effects.
The audit document records compatibility, installer/reference parity evidence, limits, end-to-end evidence, and a justified Task 11 decision.

No production code, schema, semantic capability-truth or multilingual-truth claim, provider, tag, or archive is modified; command-generated freshness and digest projections are recorded as evidence only.
Focused integration, lifecycle, verification, documentation, multilingual, installer, and governed lifecycle checks are recorded.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The completed V2 changes need a final evidence-based compatibility and public-truth audit before the remediation plan is closed.
constraints: Audit changes are limited to its integration tests and audit document.
Unsupported published claims are findings, not silently corrected here.
Task 11 starts only when a documented claim differs from verified behavior.
The audit performs no network, scheduler, provider, release, or tag action.
intent.rationale: Separating audit from correction preserves traceability and avoids treating prior assessments as proof.
